instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level medium shot. Inside a gym with exercise equipment in the background, the woman in the gray t-shirt (R2) sits exhausted on the right, wearing tan pants and looking downward. Standing on the left, the man in the green jacket (R1) has a white towel draped around his neck and leans down to talk to her supportively. Warm overhead gym lights illuminate the pair, casting soft shadows on the dark floor. An exercise bike is visible behind them.
